briefdescription.para: user-defined string literal for JSON values

detaileddescription.para: This operator implements a user-defined string literal for JSON objects. It can be used by adding "_json" to a string literal and returns a JSON object if no parse error occurred.

parameterdescription.para: a string representation of a JSON object
